stories.title: Astronomers find interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS hiding in images taken before its official discovery
stories.summary: Interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS was almost called 3I/Rubin, after researchers found that the giant survey telescope coincidentally spotted this visitor from the stars over a week before it was officially discovered.

stories.title: The shock of seeing your body used in deepfake porn
stories.summary: When Jennifer got a job doing research for a nonprofit in 2023, she ran her new professional headshot through a facial recognition program. She wanted to see if the tech would pull up the porn videos she’d made more than 10 years before, when she was in her early 20s. It did in fact return…
